name: Estelle Ceulemans - § 17 - Am 6
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: D. whereas Eurofound’s European Working Conditions Survey shows that exposure to high work intensity rose from 27 % in 2015 to 40 % in 2021 with one in three employees working at high work intensity, to tight deadlines or during their free time; whereas the effects of this are particularly stark in the case of continuous shift work, night work and systematic staff shortages;
